Rashi on Niddah 25a:11:1.hebrew: היינו דאיצטריך קרא - לרבי יהושע, דמשום עור לחודיה הוי ולד:
Rashi on Niddah 25a:11:1.english: That is why a verse was necessary - For Rabbi Yehoshua, [to teach] that due to skin alone it is an offspring.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:11:2.hebrew: אלא אי אמרת - טעמא דרבי יהושע משום דעכור הוא, ואיכא למימר נימוח, ולאו משום עור, קרא ל"ל:
Rashi on Niddah 25a:11:2.english: Rather, if you say - [That] Rabbi Yehoshua's reason is because it is turbid, and one can say [that an offspring] dissolved, and not because of skin — why do I need a verse?

Rashi on Niddah 25a:11:3.english: Rather, is it not that the dispute is regarding clear [fluid] - And [this is] a refutation of Reish Lakish.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:13:1.hebrew: אלא אמרו - רישא בבכורות פרק הלוקח בהמה מן העובד כוכבים (דף יט:), לענין לפטור את שבא אחריו מתורת בכור:
Rashi on Niddah 25a:13:1.english: Rather, they said - The first clause [of this mishna is] in Bekhorot, in the chapter 'One Who Purchases an Animal from a Gentile' (page 19b), regarding exempting that which comes after it from the status of a firstborn.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:13:2.hebrew: טינוף - לאחר שקבלה מן הזכר ונוצר הולד, נימוח וזב הימנו ויוצא והולך, ואותו טינוף פוטרתה מן הבכורה:
Rashi on Niddah 25a:13:2.english: Discharge - After [the animal] received [seed] from the male and the fetus was formed, it dissolved, flowed from it, and continued to emerge; and that discharge exempts it from [the law of the] firstborn.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:13:3.english: A gestational sac and an afterbirth - Either a gestational sac or an afterbirth.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:17:1.hebrew: ספוקי מספקא ליה - בעכור גופיה, אי ולד הוא אם לאו:
Rashi on Niddah 25a:17:1.english: He is uncertain - Regarding the turbid [fluid] itself, whether it is an offspring or not.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:17:2.hebrew: הכא לחומרא והכא לחומרא - גבי בכורת בהמה אמר דלאו ולד הוא ולא פטר את הבא אחריו, דאי אמרת פטר - קא גזיז ועביד ביה עבודה, ודילמא לאו ולד הוא ההוא קמא, וקאתי לידי תקלה. וגבי טומאת ולד אזיל לחומרא, דקאמר ולד הוא וטמאה שבועיים, וימי טוהר לא ס"ל דניתיב לה. וגבי בכור אדם, דקולא היא דקאמר פטר את הבא אחריו, ולא איכפת לן - דאין קדושה בבכור אדם אלא ממון כהן ה' סלעים, וספק ממונא לקולא, דכהן הוי מוציא מחברו עליו הראיה:
Rashi on Niddah 25a:17:2.english: Here stringently and there stringently - Regarding the firstborn of an animal, he says that it is not an offspring and does not exempt the one that comes after it — for if you were to say that it exempts [it], [the owner] would shear [it] and perform labor with it, and perhaps that first one was not an offspring, and he would come to a pitfall. And regarding the impurity of childbirth, he proceeds stringently, as he says that it is an offspring and [therefore] she is impure for two weeks, but he does not hold that we should grant her days of purity. And regarding the firstborn of man, where it is a leniency that he says [the sac] exempts the one that comes after it, we are not concerned — for there is no [intrinsic] sanctity in a human firstborn, but only money [owed to] the priest, five selas; and uncertainty regarding monetary matters is [resolved] leniently, as the priest is the one seeking to extract [payment] from his fellow, [and] the burden of proof rests upon him.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:1:1.english: Parashtevina - [This is] the name of the man.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:21:1.english: This is Rabbi - Who said above, "I have not heard."

Rashi on Niddah 25a:21:2.english: And surely Rabbi Yishmael - Who said [that if it is] full of flesh, she is impure [with the impurity of] childbirth.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:21:3.english: And behold, Rabbi Oshaya - Who said [that] the dispute is regarding turbid [fluid].

Rashi on Niddah 25a:21:4.english: But surely Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi - Who said [that] the dispute is regarding clear [fluid].

Rashi on Niddah 25a:22:1.english: Both this and that - Both a turbid one and a clear one.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:22:2.hebrew: חוששת - ויושבת ימי טומאה, ואין לה ימי טוהר, דספק ולד הוא ולא ודאי:
Rashi on Niddah 25a:22:2.english: She must be concerned - And she observes the days of impurity, but she has no days of purity, for it is an uncertain offspring and not a definite [one].

Rashi on Niddah 25a:23:1.hebrew: לא דכו שפיר - לא טיהרו את המפלת שפיר משבועים, ואפי' בלידה יבישתא:
Rashi on Niddah 25a:23:1.english: They did not declare a gestational sac pure - They did not declare a woman who discharges a gestational sac pure from [the] two weeks [of impurity], and even in a dry birth.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:24:1.english: Drops of a fly - The eyes of a fly.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:25:1.hebrew: ופיו מתוח כחוט השערה - סדק קטן, ונראה כאילו חוט השערה מתוח שם:
Rashi on Niddah 25a:25:1.english: And its mouth is stretched like a strand of hair - A small slit, and it looks as though a strand of hair is stretched there.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:25:2.hebrew: גויתו - גיד אבר הזכר. והא דתנן: תשב לזכר ולנקבה, אלמא מספקא לן אם זכר אם נקבה — כשאין ניכר בו האבר מיירי:
Rashi on Niddah 25a:25:2.english: Its body - [This refers to] the member, the male organ. And that which we learned in the mishna: "She shall sit for a male and for a female," from which it is evident that we are uncertain whether [it is] a male or a female — [the mishna] is dealing with [a case] where the organ is not discernible on it.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:25:3.english: Like a grain of barley - It is split along its length.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:26:1.hebrew: וחיתוך ידים ורגלים - עדיין אין נראין, כדאמרינן תחלת ברייתו מראשו:
Rashi on Niddah 25a:26:1.english: And the delineation of hands and feet - They are not yet visible, as we say: "The beginning of its creation is from its head."

Rashi on Niddah 25a:26:2.hebrew: כחלב - זהו שכבת זרע, שהוא ניתך וקלוש מתחלה בשעת יציאתו כחלב, ואח"כ נעשה קפוי:
Rashi on Niddah 25a:26:2.english: Like milk - This is the semen, which is fluid and thin initially, at the time of its emission, like milk, and afterward it becomes congealed.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:5:1.hebrew: כסומכוס - בריש פירקין, דם שבתוך החתיכה מטמא משום נדה, ויחידאה היא:
Rashi on Niddah 25a:5:1.english: Like Sumakhos - At the beginning of our chapter, blood that is inside the piece renders [her] impure on account of a menstruant, and it is an individual [opinion].

Rashi on Niddah 25a:5:2.hebrew: כר' יהושע אמרה - דמשום עור שפיר לחודיה מטמא [משום לידה. ויחידאה היא, דדילמא אפילו במלא בשר פליגי, כיון דאינו מרוקם, מעולם לא היה ולד. ואע"ג דפליג רבי יהושע בשפיר לחודיה, במלא דם מודה דלאו ולד הוא, דדם מוכיח עליו]:
Rashi on Niddah 25a:5:2.english: He said it in accordance with Rabbi Yehoshua - For on account of the membrane of the gestational sac alone, [Rabbi Yehoshua] deems [her] impure [on account of childbirth. And it is an individual opinion, for perhaps the Rabbis disagree even with regard to a sac full of flesh, since it is unformed, it was never an offspring. And even though Rabbi Yehoshua disagrees regarding the gestational sac alone, with regard to a sac full of blood he concedes that it is not an offspring, for the blood proves about it].

Rashi on Niddah 25a:7:1.hebrew: בעכור - מה שבתוכו עכור, דאיכא למימר: ולד היה ונימוח:
Rashi on Niddah 25a:7:1.english: In [a case where it is] turbid - That which is inside it is turbid, for one can say: It was an offspring, and it dissolved.

Rashi on Niddah 25a:7:2.english: In [a] clear [sac] - That it is full of clear water.

Tosafot on Niddah 25a:13:1.hebrew: סימן ולד בבהמה דקה טינוף - האי טינוף הוא ולד עצמו, ולא דמי לטינוף דלקמן, דרוב בהמות מטנפות, דהתם טינוף של אחר יצירת הולד:
Tosafot on Niddah 25a:13:1.english: An indication of an offspring in a small animal is a discharge - This discharge is the offspring itself, and it is not similar to the discharge [discussed] later, that "most animals emit a discharge," for there, [it is] a discharge [occurring] after the formation of the offspring.

Tosafot on Niddah 25a:19:1.hebrew: גבי בהמה לחומרא - ואע"ג דקולא הוא שמוציאין ממון מרשות ישראל, היינו משום דאי לא יהיב לכהן, אתי למשרי בגיזה ועבודה:
Tosafot on Niddah 25a:19:1.english: Regarding an animal, [he rules] stringently - And even though it is a leniency that we extract money from the possession of an Israelite, this is because if he does not give [it] to the priest, he will come to permit [it] for shearing and labor.

Tosafot on Niddah 25a:1:1.hebrew: פרשתבינא - פ"ה: שם איש, וכן בערוך. ואינו כן, דאם כן ה"ל למימר מפומבדיתא; אלא פרשב"ם: לשון פרנסות וממשלה:
Tosafot on Niddah 25a:1:1.english: Parashtevina - The Kuntres [Rashi] explained [that it is] a person's name, and so [too] in the Arukh. But this is not so, for if so, it should have said "from Pumbedita" (mi-Pumbedita); rather, the Rashbam explained [that it is] an expression of leadership and governance.

Tosafot on Niddah 25a:22:1.english: She is not concerned - And Rav maintains that the dispute between [Rabbi Yehoshua] and the Rabbis is regarding turbid [fluid].

Tosafot on Niddah 25a:24:1.hebrew: תחלת ברייתו מראשו - תימה, דבפ' בתרא דסוטה (דף מה:) קסבר אבא שאול: תחלת ברייתו מטיבורו, ומשלח שרשיו אילך ואילך. ונראה לר"ת דגרס ברשון, וכן פר"ח. ובתוספתא פירש: כעין חגב, דסלעם מתרגמינן רשון. וכן משמע, דמיירי בשיעור האברים:
Tosafot on Niddah 25a:24:1.english: The beginning of its formation is from its head - [This is] puzzling, for in the last chapter of Sotah (daf 45b), Abba Shaul holds [that] the beginning of its formation is from its navel, and it sends forth its roots here and there. And it appears to Rabbeinu Tam that the reading is *rashon*, and so Rabbeinu Chananel explained. And in the Tosefta it explains [it as] "like a type of locust," for *sale'am* [bald locust] is translated [in the Targum as] *rashon*. And it also implies thus, that [the baraita] is dealing with the size of the organs.

Tosafot on Niddah 25a:26:1.hebrew: עור ובשר תלבישני ועצמות וגידים תסוככני - ברישא עור ובשר, והדר עצמות וגידים. ובתחיית המתים דיחזקאל (סימן לז), איפכא: גידין, והדר בשר. ומפרש במדרש: למה הדבר דומה? לאדם שפושט וחוזר ולובש: מה שפושט ראשון, לובש אחרון; אבל בתחלת בריית הולד, עור ובשר תחלה, ואח"כ עצמות וגידין:
Tosafot on Niddah 25a:26:1.english: You clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews - First [the verse mentions] skin and flesh, and then bones and sinews. And regarding the resurrection of the dead in Ezekiel (chapter 37), [it is] the reverse: sinews, and then flesh. And it is explained in the Midrash: To what is the matter comparable? To a person who undresses and dresses again: that which he removes first, he puts on last; but at the initial formation of the fetus, skin and flesh [come] first, and afterwards bones and sinews.

Tosafot on Niddah 25a:2:1.hebrew: מלא בשר מהו - ממתני' דקתני מלא דם ומלא מים, ליכא למפשט; דדילמא הא מלא בשר חוששת, אבל ודאי ולד לא הוי. א"נ, הא דלא חשיב, משום דבפלוגתא לא מיירי:
Tosafot on Niddah 25a:2:1.english: [A gestational sac] full of flesh, what is [the halakha]? - From our Mishnah, which teaches '[a sac] full of blood and [a sac] full of water', it cannot be resolved; for perhaps [in the case of] this [sac] full of flesh, she must be concerned [that it is an offspring], but it is not definitely an offspring. Alternatively, that which [the Mishnah] did not reckon [it] is because it does not deal with [matters of] dispute.

Tosafot on Niddah 25a:5:1.hebrew: שמא כר' יהושע - אע"ג דבעי למימר בסמוך מחלוקת בצלול, אבל בעכור דברי הכל ולד, רבי נמי מסופק היה בהא, דהא קאמר שמא:
Tosafot on Niddah 25a:5:1.english: Perhaps in accordance with Rabbi Yehoshua - Even though [the Gemara] wants to say nearby [that] the dispute is regarding a clear [sac], but regarding a turbid [sac] everyone agrees [that it is] an offspring, Rabbi, too, was in doubt about this, for behold, he said: "Perhaps."

Tosafot on Niddah 25a:5:2.hebrew: (לעיל) כסומכוס - וא"ת: ואם שפיר מלא דם הוי כחתיכה שבתוכה דם, שפיר מלא בשר נמי להוי כחתיכה של בשר, דאמר בפירקין דאינה טמאה לידה כשאין בה עצם? ויש לומר: דשפיר דמיא לולד טפי מחתיכה, וטמא אפילו אין בה עצם, אע"ג דבמלא דם שניהם שוים:
Tosafot on Niddah 25a:5:2.english: (Earlier) In accordance with Sumakhos - And if you say: If a gestational sac full of blood is [treated] like a piece [of flesh] that has blood inside it, a gestational sac full of flesh should also be like a piece of flesh, regarding which [the Gemara] says in our chapter that she is not impure with [the impurity of] childbirth when there is no bone in it? And one can say that a gestational sac resembles a fetus more than a piece [of flesh] [does], and [therefore] imparts impurity even if there is no bone in it, even though with regard to [one that is] full of blood both of them are equal.

Tosafot on Niddah 25a:7:1.hebrew: מחלוקת בצלול - פ"ה מלא מים, וכן משמע. וקשה: וכי עדיף ממלאה דם, דאמר לעיל דטמאה נדה ולא לידה, אפי' לרבי יהושע? לכך נראה לפרש, דצלול ועכור היינו בשר עכור ובשר צלול:
Tosafot on Niddah 25a:7:1.english: The dispute is regarding clear - Rashi explained: Full of water, and so it implies. And this is difficult: Is [a sac full of water] any better than [one] filled with blood, regarding which it was stated above that she is impure [with the impurity of] a menstruating woman (niddah) and not [with that of] childbirth, even according to Rabbi Yehoshua? Therefore, it seems [correct] to explain that "clear" and "turbid" mean turbid flesh and clear flesh.

Tosafot on Niddah 25a:9:1.hebrew: שאין הקב"ה עושה עור כו' - דכתנות עור בעור אדם מיירי, כדמתרגמינן: על משך בשריהון:
Tosafot on Niddah 25a:9:1.english: That the Holy One, Blessed be He, does not make skin, etc. - For "garments of skin" refers to human skin, as we translate [in the Targum]: "upon the skin of their flesh."
